documented.title: Generate and edit videos with Gemini Omni Flash
documented.transition: gemini-omni-1.1-flash remains available during a 4-week transition window; from 2026-12-03 every request to gemini-omni-1.1-flash routes to gemini-omni-1.2-flash with no code change and is billed at the lower Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash rates

request.input: list of {type: image, data: base64, mime_type} followed by {type: text, text}; image to video sends one image, first and last frame send two images before the text

response_format.duration: any whole second from 3 to 15 as a string such as "3s"; the model defaults to 10 seconds; a duration set in response_format is used instead of any length in the text prompt; over 15 seconds is an invalid argument
response_format.delivery: uri for outputs larger than 4 MB

request.first_and_last_frame: 3 to 10 seconds; both frames with a duration over 10 seconds is an invalid argument
request.reference_images: up to 6 per request; up to 3 images per character for up to 2 characters
request.task_note: the guide prefers natural language and names the task as a fallback that adds strict constraints
request.background: the guide recommends false for synchronous generation
request.store: false means the result cannot be edited or extended in a later turn

output.location: steps[] model_output with type video, mime_type video/mp4, data (base64) or uri; interaction.output_video is SDK-only
output.durations: 3 to 15 s; 3 to 10 s for first and last frame and for each extension turn, extensions up to 30 s in total (model card)

limits.max_prompt_length: not stated on the page read
limits.image_limits: not stated on the page read; the guide asks for high-resolution images

prompting.image_to_video: use high-resolution images and provide specific motion descriptions; vague prompts like "make it move" produce less compelling results than detailed descriptions of the camera movement, subject motion, and environmental effects
prompting.single_shot: say a single continuous shot or no scene cuts
prompting.timing: natural language or timecodes such as [0-5s]
prompting.audio: generated with the video and steered through the prompt; no switch to turn it off is stated

pricing.unit: USD per second of output video
pricing.formula: video output tokens per second of the resolution x 12.00 USD per 1M video output tokens; input tokens (1.50 USD per 1M) are not in the estimate
pricing.not_stated: separate prices for edit and extension turns; batch, flex and priority rows; a free tier

registry.max_seconds: 10: the registry ceiling and the first and last frame limit; one image allows up to 15 seconds
registry.durations: [3]: the clip length the moto shot plans are written for; longer lengths change the capabilities Phase 7 plans with
